name: MORE
description: Extracting relational facts from multimodal data is a crucial task in the field of multimedia and knowledge graphs that feeds into widespread real-world applications. The emphasis of recent studies centers on recognizing relational facts in which both entities are present in one modality and supplementary information is used from other modalities. However, such works disregard a substantial amount of multimodal relational facts that arise across different modalities, such as one entity seen in a text and another in an image. In this paper, we propose a new task, namely Multimodal Object-Entity Relation Extraction, which aims to extract "object-entity" relational facts from image and text data. To facilitate research on this task, we introduce MORE, a new dataset comprising 21 relation types and 20,264 multimodal relational facts annotated on 3,559 pairs of textual news titles and corresponding images. reputation: A specialized multimodal relation extraction dataset that is useful for studying cross-modal entity-relationship reasoning, but not yet broadly adopted as a standard benchmark.
notes: Moderate-sized dataset with news-image pairs; evaluation is typically relation-level F1 and the task is sensitive to annotation quality and cross-modal grounding errors.
